item.text: The shared cache key includes the operation and entity ID but omits the tenant, so summaries for the same period collide. I’ll add a tenant namespace to the shared read path and test back-to-back reads without intervening writes—the existing test’s write clears the cache and hides the bug.

item.text:
Fixed the shared read path to include the tenant in cache keys, preventing cross-tenant invoice summary and customer leaks while preserving caching.

Regression tests reproduced the leak in both tenant orders before the fix. All **16 tests now pass**, including internal-tenant cache bypass checks.

Changes are local; not deployed to production.
